Chronology of every recorded fact about [[dreadbeasts]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Soulsmith ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 5''' — Dreadbeasts crash into the land like waves of the sea.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 7''' — Dreadbeasts are creatures that mining crews need protection from.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 11''' — Dreadbeasts are found in the Ruins.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 14''' — Dreadbeasts are coming to the area.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 14''' — Dreadbeasts appear suddenly and attack miners.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 16''' — Yerin fought a pack of twisted dreadbeasts.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 17''' — A dreadbeast attacked Lindon, causing twisted fingers.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 17''' — Dreadbeasts are creatures that stand in the way of progress.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 17''' — Dreadbeasts gather where vital aura is thick.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 18''' — Dreadbeasts are multi-headed masses of corrupted flesh.}}

* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 1''' — Dreadbeasts keep their souls in their bodies and leave no Remnants.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 1''' — Dreadbeasts can eat Remnants to process their madra.}}
